finalText:
Builds clean now, `0 errors`.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js`: `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, which threw and aborted the link stage. Changed it to `env.retries || 3`.

The other three lines were just warnings, not errors — a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export, and a circular import. Build still reports those 3 warnings but exits 0.
